item.title: Talawanda Preschool Application Lottery 2026-2027
item.description:
Applications are now open for the Talawanda Preschool lottery for the 2026-2027 school year. Typically developing children will enter through a lottery process to fill limited spaces. Applications must be completed by January 31, 2026, and the lottery will take place on February 13, 2026. Families will be notified of their placement or waitlist status after the lottery date. Questions can be directed to Preschool Coordinator Beth Fuechsl at fuechsle@talawanda.org. Preschool Application

item.title: Head Lice Prevention and Treatment Reminder
item.description:
Parents are reminded to check their children's hair regularly for head lice to help prevent spread at school. If lice or nits are found, begin treatment promptly and notify the school nurse. According to CDC guidelines, students with head lice do not need to be sent home early—they can be treated at the end of the day and return to school after beginning appropriate treatment. Resources available: CDC Head Lice and TSD Head Lice Information.

item.title: Cold and Flu Season Guidelines
item.description:
Cold and flu season is here. Students should stay home with: fever of 100°F or higher, frequent coughing or difficulty breathing, diarrhea or vomiting, body rash with fever, active head lice, eye infection with discharge, or sore throat with congestion. Students may return when fever-free for 24 hours without fever-reducing medication, symptoms improve, and specific conditions are met for each illness. If your child is absent due to illness, call the attendance line and submit any doctor's notes to the front office.

item.title: Cold and Flu Season Guidelines
item.description:
Cold and flu season has arrived. When to stay home from school: fever of 100°F or higher, frequent/continual coughing or difficulty breathing, diarrhea or vomiting, body rash with fever, active head lice, eye infection with discharge, or sore throat with congestion. When to return: fever-free for 24 hours without fever-reducing medication (ibuprofen or acetaminophen), mild/infrequent cough, tolerating food for 12+ hours, rash improvement, after first head lice treatment, or 24 hours after starting eye drops/ointment. For COVID-19 positive cases, return when fever-free for 24 hours without medication and symptoms are minimal/improving. Call the attendance line when your child is sick, and submit doctor's notes to the front office.
